description: Add TUI-only footer/widget and a read-only /todo-db panel driven from agent claims/context. Refresh on session lifecycle and successful mutations, handle zero/one/multiple claims explicitly, and omit the proposed v1 timer heartbeat because normal progress refreshes a 24-hour lease and idle work should expire.

anti_patterns.instead: refresh on genuine lifecycle mutations and let idle leases expire
anti_patterns.why: it adds timer complexity and audit churn for a 24-hour TTL

anti_patterns.dont: Poll only to keep the display fresh
anti_patterns.instead: refresh on lifecycle, mutation, and explicit panel open
anti_patterns.why: remote opens add cost with no model benefit

anti_patterns.dont: Store tracker snapshots in Pi entries
anti_patterns.why: the session would become a second source of truth

preserves.behavior: Multiple legacy claims are shown as a conflict and never silently reduced to one
No timer renewals or background write loop in v1
UI failures never change or roll back tracker state

verifications.command: cd integrations/pi && npm test && npm run typecheck
